newsitem.title: OMAN: OPIC in $30 mln loan to Arab investment fund.
newsitem.headline: OPIC in $30 mln loan to Arab investment fund.

text.p: The U.S. Overseas Private Investment Corp (OPIC) granted the Inter-Arab Investment Fund a $30 million loan raising the capital of the newly-formed portfolio to $45 million, Omani newspapers reported on Monday.
They said Omani and Jordanian investors contributed $15 million towards the fund's paid up capital.
The fund, which is designed to have a lifetime of 10 to 12 years, would be looking to invest up to $3 million in individual projects within the region and in the United States.
The Amman-based fund would set up a branch in the Omani capital Muscat, the papers added.

OPIC, a U.S. government agency, insures U.S. companies' investments abroad from risks including takeover of their assets by foreign governments. OPIC has a 15-member board that sets its underwriting and lending policies.
